answer: In PoA, EigenTrust derives each agent’s global score from recursively normalized peer endorsements, while temporal decay halves reputation at a fixed interval. Honest influence therefore requires sustained, reciprocal service. A freshly spawned Sybil identity—whether labeled comet, walnut, or falcon—starts with near-zero eigenvector centrality and no trusted paths. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity prevents borrowed rank, so it cannot reach consensus thresholds without durable history.
